# Smooth connected subgroups generated by families

Worker 1296, adapting the maximum-dimension proof by Worker 1342 in
`FiniteGeneration`.

This internal derived module extracts the maximum-dimension argument already
implemented in `FiniteGeneration.exists_finite_generating_subfamily`, before
that theorem applies its all-family generation hypothesis. It does not assume
that the family generates the ambient group.

For an arbitrary field `k : Type u`, a smooth affine group scheme `G`, and a
family indexed by an independent `I : Type v`, `IsGeneratedByFamily A a i`
means that `i : H ⟶ G` is closed, contains every actual homomorphism `a j`, and
its subgroup functor on every test scheme lies in every closed competitor
containing the family. The predicate alone imposes no smoothness or
connectedness. Competitors may be nonsmooth and nonreduced.

`FiniteGeneration.exists_generated_family` assumes that every finite
subfamily has a smooth connected affine generated representative. Their Lie
dimensions are bounded by the ambient Lie dimension, because a closed
immersion has injective differential. The proof chooses a representative of
maximum dimension. After adjoining any further family member, minimality
factors the selected representative through the enlarged one. The factor is
closed. If it were not an isomorphism, strict dimension decrease for proper
closed subgroups of a smooth connected affine group would contradict the
choice. Its inverse thus factors the additional member through the selected
representative. The selected representative contains the whole family;
minimality for its original finite subfamily gives all-family minimality.

`exists_generated_family_of_pointedImageGeneration` uses the published finite
construction with an explicit `PointedImageGenerationStatement` premise.
`exists_smooth_generated_family` discharges that premise with the published
`ImageGeneration.pointedImageGeneration` proof. Thus every family of smooth
connected affine sources has a smooth connected affine closed generated
representative. The ambient group need not be connected, the family maps need
not be embeddings, and the empty family is allowed. No infinitude, perfection,
characteristic, splitness or positive-dimension restriction is added.

The provenance is the existing finite-generation proof and its published
pointed-image construction; the extraction and all-family predicate are
internal derived content. Every containment is on all test schemes, including
nonreduced tests. This module supplies a smooth envelope for the Cartan
induction argument; it asserts neither Cartan generation nor any centralizer
smoothness or spanning theorem.
